basis: Stock game assets; no third-party regeneration payload is included.
rate: Configurable 0 to 5 percent per second; 0.25 steps through 2, then 0.5. Default 1.5. In segment-limited mode, BloodPercentRegenPerSecond += percentage/100 * live BloodSegmentCount; the native MMC supplies period and regeneration multiplier.
preservesPermanentDamage: Default vampire mode preserves permanent damage. Optional segment restoration recovers only the permanent damage needed for each tick.
name: Health Regen - Configurable
humanRate: HealthRegen += human percentage/100 * live MaxHealth, with the native period, regeneration multiplier and permanent-damage-adjusted clamp.
humanEligibility: Human form, alive and not invulnerable. Combat is excluded by default; combatRegen=1 permits combat. Parent legacy and component eligibility are refreshed after settings changes.

segmentMode.calculation: heal = min(max(0, capacity - blood), capacity * rate); unlock = -min(permanentDamage, max(0, heal - max(0, capacity - permanentDamage - blood)))
segmentMode.zeroDefaults: All added coefficients start at zero. Contradictory application tag requirements block automatic segment-effect application. Both calculation classes have a zero-result native parent. After loading completion and a verified native binding, Lua opens the gate for one explicit application and restores it synchronously, including failures.
segmentMode.dispatch: Two private native virtual-table calculation bindings on the owned calculation class defaults, with an actual-call probe before activation. The shared game table is unchanged. The calculation assets inherit the native zero-result GameplayModMagnitudeCalculation base. No Lua on regeneration ticks.

settings.apply: Read through the shared settings store after loading completion, using the native loading-widget fade-out event as well as the combat loading notification. An active loading widget must finish before setup resumes. Construction and possession cannot bypass the gate. Setup and cleanup pause during loading. Ordinary player replacement retains the current settings snapshot. No startup settings I/O or polling.

commonLibrary.packaging: Bundled immutable source copies; source, staged and archived bytes verified against the lock.
